description: Replit turns your ideas into real, running web apps and websites, with no coding or setup required. Describe what you want in plain language and Replit's AI Agent builds a working app for you (frontend, backend, database, and auth as needed), then hosts it so you can use and share it right away. Keep the conversation going to refine and extend your app, ask how a feature works, or check whether it's ready to deploy. It's great for rapid prototyping, quick experiments, internal tools, and turning ideas into something you can actually run as fast as you can describe them.
